# Al-Imran Muslim Aid

> A registered charity in Uganda and East Africa empowering communities through sustainable development, education, and compassionate humanitarian action for the Ummah.

Al-Imran Muslim Aid (AIMA) runs projects in education, healthcare, water, food security, and emergency relief. Visitors can donate funds or items, volunteer, become members, or follow urgent appeals.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Mission overview, impact stats, featured projects, urgent appeals.
- [About Us](/about): History, leadership team, and values.
- [Our Projects](/projects): Active humanitarian initiatives.
- [Donate Funds](/donate): Support projects financially via PayPal or Pesapal.
- [Donate Items](/donate-items): Contribute physical goods.
- [Membership](/membership): Become a member.
- [Volunteer](/volunteer): Join volunteer programs.
- [Urgent Appeals](/urgent-appeals): Time-sensitive humanitarian needs.
- [Blog & News](/blog): Stories of impact and field updates.
- [Careers](/careers): Open positions.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach out to the team.
